result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but one clear visual defect stands out: a loading spinner is still displayed on top of the fully rendered hero image of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, making the card look stuck/broken. A couple of minor contrast/consistency issues are also present. Carousel edge clipping and bottom-viewport cutoff were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a circular loading spinner centered over an image that already appears fully loaded. The persistent spinner over rendered content reads as a stuck/broken loading state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner as soon as the image finishes decoding (onLoad), and add a timeout/error fallback so a spinner never remains over visible content. If the image is intentionally still loading, show a skeleton/blur placeholder instead of the finished artwork under the spinner.

issues.description: The search field placeholder ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving low contrast that may fail WCAG 1.4.3 for readable text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (e.g., #6B7280 or darker) or lighten the field background so contrast reaches at least 4.5:1.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the first card uses a flat light-gray illustrated thumbnail while the neighboring cards use dark photographic-style backgrounds, creating an inconsistent visual rhythm in the row.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (consistent background tone, aspect ratio and padding) across carousel cards so the row looks cohesive.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' cards show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards show rating, time and cuisine; the ETA badge is the only metadata on the small cards, leaving them visually sparse and uneven in information density.
issues.suggestion: Add a compact rating or cuisine line to the small cards, or align metadata placement so both sections share a consistent information hierarchy.
